messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — finished the 7B quant bring-up across us-east/us-west/eu-west. Major p95 variance, likely edge routing + kernel mismatch. attaching quick numbers :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ryan: can you paste the perf table?
maya: ```
region       gpu   kv-cache   p50   p95   qps_tok/s  GPU%  kernel
us-east      H100  warm       38ms  72ms  2400       62    fused-mha
us-west      A100  warm       52ms  150ms 1800       75    fast-attn-v2
eu-west      H100  warm       64ms  170ms 1600       68    fast-attn-v2
(when routed via edge-hop) p95s jump +60-80ms on top of above
```
sophia: "Edge-hop" meaning cross-pop egress -> extra proxy?
maya: yes — we saw a test where eu-west routed through us-east edge (bad route) and eu p95 went to ~230ms, p50 +20ms. cold KV-cache adds another ~30-40ms p95 tail on first tokens.
oliver: tried a micro-canary changing kernel to fused-mha on us-west pool — p95 dropped from 150ms -> ~95ms, p50 52->44ms. throughput +/-5%.
infra-bot: deploy-canary: fused-mha enabled on eng-ml-us-west pool (canary id=canary-3392)
ryan: any quality regressions from the quant + kernel combo?
maya: ran eval set (500 prompts) with PQ5 quant. no statistically significant regressions on BLEU/ROUGE/semantic sims. need longer convo tests but initial looks fine.
sophia: tradeoffs? memory or ops changes?
oliver: fused-mha uses a bit more temp memory on A100 but reduces kernel launches; net effect = lower latency but slightly higher peak mem. on H100 it's a win both latency + mem.
maya: operational recs: 1) prefer local-pop routing for 95% traffic, 2) enable fused-mha on A100 pools (canary first), 3) set kv-cache prewarm=1 for streaming endpoints, 4) batch size=4 default for this model.
ryan: capacity sizing notes?
maya: if we keep fast-attn on A100, need ~+1 GPU per 20k tok/s to hit p95 SLO. with fused-mha we can avoid that extra node in most cases. eu-west may still need extra headroom for burst/fallback.
oliver: i'll open PR for canary config + routing policy tweak, assign to @maya and @sophia.
maya: thanks — will follow up with the full graphs and a short runbook. link: https://internal.redwood/graphs/7b-geo-kernel-1719954321
infra-bot: note: incident-124 auto-closed (related metric alert resolved)
